dialogue.text: WOO! Okay, my fingers are cramping! That thing is WAY faster than its walk cycle!
My ears are ringing. Felt like a stampede with a beat more than a song.
Containment field fluctuating! Bio-signatures are off the charts! Ma'am, you must cease all sonic provocations immediately!
See? It got stunned for a second! Now it's entering its rage mode! This is its second phase!
PJ, that horn is not a cosmetic item. Please try not to get impaled by the 'second phase'.
Don't worry, OJ! I got this! Locking the fuck in!
